metadata.selection_rule: the sole candidate must have positive mean daily RankIC on the frozen 22-session label, at least 0.95 coverage, and absolute rank correlation below 0.70 versus Alpha158_20, Amihud20HistoricalProxy, and every frozen same-provider candidate through v2.7
metadata.provider_price_contract: The pinned investment_data Qlib Provider supplies adjusted stock and SH000300 close values. Returns are calculated directly from those normalized close series; factor is not multiplied into close a second time.
metadata.market_proxy_contract: SH000300 adjusted close from the same immutable Provider is broadcast by date as benchmark_close. This avoids future-constituent leakage from constructing a market return with the static union of historical CSI300 members.
metadata.formation_policy: For every target calendar month, estimate one Dimson market beta from stock and SH000300 daily close returns in the preceding three complete calendar months. Regress stock return on lagged, contemporaneous, and one-session-lead benchmark returns with an intercept and sum the three slopes. Require at least 20 complete observations and a full-rank design. The final regression row must have its benchmark lead known by the prior month end, so the prior month final session is excluded. Hold the score constant throughout the target month.
metadata.holding_policy: Use the paper-supported one-month horizon: a 22-session forward label, Top 50, n_drop=1, and a 21-session minimum holding period. Do not alter the beta direction, three-month formation window, minimum observations, benchmark, label, validation segment, or execution contract after viewing results.
metadata.paper_definition: Wan and Zhang estimate A-share CAPM beta monthly from daily excess returns over a three-month rolling window, include one lead and one lag of market returns following Dimson, sum the three slopes, require at least 20 observations, and document a positive beta-return relation in China over 2000-2020.
metadata.paper_proxy_difference: The paper uses all A-shares, an all-A-share value-weighted market index, excess returns, value-weighted decile portfolios, and additional eligibility filters. QuantaAlpha uses point-in-time CSI300 members, SH000300, raw adjusted-close returns, a monthly constant long-only TopK signal, and next-session-open execution. This is Beta3M-CSI300-LongOnly-Proxy, not a paper replication and not a guaranteed independent alpha.

1b7913109f79fb5a.factor_description: Sum of lagged, contemporaneous, and lead SH000300 return slopes estimated from the preceding three complete calendar months, held constant during the target month. Higher scores identify larger recent market-risk exposure.
1b7913109f79fb5a.factor_formulation: Beta3M(t) = beta_lag + beta_0 + beta_lead from r_i,d = alpha + beta_lag*r_m,d-1 + beta_0*r_m,d + beta_lead*r_m,d+1 + epsilon over the prior three complete calendar months; minimum 20 complete rows; no market lead after formation month end

metadata.hypothesis: Within the point-in-time CSI300 universe, stocks with higher recent three-month Dimson beta earn higher returns over the next month because market risk is positively priced in the highly synchronous A-share market.

feedback.reason: The sole candidate, market proxy, regression timing, observation floor, direction, period, label, and execution contract were frozen before its factor values, RankIC, forward returns, cache, or strategy result were produced.

consistency_check.reason: Summing the three Dimson slopes matches the paper's market-beta definition and positive beta-return direction; restricting every regression lead to information known at the prior month end prevents future leakage.
